acceptance: canonical surface data, conforming topology, explicit numerical budgets and measured work. Bevy visual/implementation parity, whole-system large_cbt replacement, game FPS, remote CI and blind subjective acceptance are not claimed.

implementation.rcbt_core_conforming_surface: SurfaceAddress::from_cube/tile/sample: exact bisector->canonical face-UV mapping over 2^29 numerators with closed upper edge, deterministic shared-edge ownership (X, then Y, then Z), single page_id(TileKey) implementation of the existing material/height quadtree identity (legacy terrain tile_node_id now delegates), depth-58 addresses never rounded before page ownership is decided
implementation.height_borrow: render-wgpu ConformingSurface + HeightSurfaceSource borrow the live metadata/residuals buffers and the sparse directory republished inside TerrainRenderer::publish_partition(); no second allocator, cache, uploader or streamer; reorder/generation/eviction/refill handled by the existing owner; missing face resolves to explicit zero height
implementation.material_borrow: TerrainRenderer::material_binding() shares the existing MaterialArray texture/sampler/sparse directory; lookup helpers extracted into shared rcbt-core shaders/page_directory.wgsl (MATERIAL_SAMPLE_WGSL is that chunk plus the original body)
implementation.precision_charts: six camera-local TileAnchor/GpuTileFrame charts (PRECISION_LEVEL=12) chosen per vertex; f64 camera subtraction reused; local chart integer origin subtracted from exact UV numerators before f32 narrowing; shared seam/corner/deep vertices select one chart
implementation.emission: one compute dispatch per pool: virtual roots zeroed, live leaves decode integer cube triangle, canonical height, shared normal, and write 48-byte vertex records (position+height, normal+face, UV numerators+source slot+level). VERTEX_BYTES=48
implementation.height_bound: rcbt-wgpu SphereGpu::set_height_bound publishes a conservative surface-height chord at Params.surface (uniform offset 128) and inflates pixel_area() by (1 + 2h/L)^2, feeding both split and merge thresholds; TerrainRenderer::height_bound_chord() derives it from canonical page residency
implementation.shadow_caster: render-wgpu ShadowAtlas owns an unbiased diagnostic conforming_pipeline/conforming_layout beside the unchanged biased legacy terrain and mesh casters; encode_conforming_casters draws emitted vertices into every active layer, applying shadow_clip * vec4(position,1) directly in camera-relative space
implementation.ocean_geometry: ConformingSurface::set_ocean borrows OceanField/material residency using existing resolved ocean policy; emission restores datum before a near-field extent/count reduction and filtered radial deformation. One common footprint preserves duplicate vertices at mixed depths. No second FFT, cache, streamer, or datum backup. Disabled/optical-only removes the consumer entirely; budget overflow/coarse geometry keeps datum. No production mode selects it.

deep_precision.limits: vertex arithmetic vs independent CPU TileAnchor::project_body_m reference over the same quantized pages; no tessellation/chord, analytic-height, silhouette or astronomical-rotation bound
deep_precision.residency: reorder, generation change, eviction and refill of source pages republished by the legacy owner (second unchanged publication regenerates 0); missing face -> zero-height fallback

target_cost_and_shared_material_raster.material_generation_change: all-red page generation -> red channel dominant, all-green -> green dominant in the actual indirect draw
target_cost_and_shared_material_raster.zero_upload_republish: third update_materials() with unchanged bytes uploads 0 bytes; topology and surface-vertex buffers byte-identical before/after
target_cost_and_shared_material_raster.limits: emission of every active slot including zeroed virtual roots, no dirty culling or view early-out; GPU timestamps only; excludes topology, classification, page publication and initialization; not game FPS

height_bound_classification.api: rcbt-wgpu::SphereGpu::set_height_bound(height_chord) -> Params.surface at uniform offset 128; set_view writes only the first 128 bytes
height_bound_classification.inflation: pixel_area *= (1 + 2h/L)^2, L = longest chord edge; same value feeds split and merge thresholds

canonical_derivation.source: per-slot resident height extent (min_height_m - max_residual_error_m, max_height_m + max_residual_error_m), tracked alongside shadow and ocean bounds, cleared on slot eviction
canonical_derivation.folding: widest active extent -> max|h| / body_radius_m, clamped to one chord
verified: 100 m page -> exact max|height +/- residual| / radius
manual update to -4 km page widens the bound
republishing the same page holds it
canonical_derivation.limits: body-wide scalar, cannot express per-tile relief; no production mode or classifier call site consumes it yet

height_bound_classification.limits: conservative inflation of the LOD measure only, not a bound on rendered height error

shadow_canonical_oracle.scene: six constant 20 m face pages, body radius 1000 m, height grid 33, 1 cascade, 512 px atlas, 2000 m cover, three distinct sun directions
shadow_canonical_oracle.oracle: central half-radius disk rays must hit between R and sqrt(R^2-D^2/3), R=1020 m and D=longest CPU triangle edge; geometric depth plus 0.002 m arithmetic tolerance. Unbiased diagnostic raster; legacy caster comparison no longer an acceptance gate.
shadow_canonical_oracle.corrections: Supersedes unsupported normalized 0.02 tessellation-envelope claim and concatenated-layer extent claims. Real depth-4 roots 16..27 emit geometry at local_depth=0; only 28..31 are virtual. At R=1000, level-11 cube width is about 0.977 m, not 15 m. Flat layer-major zipping pairs matching texels.
shadow_canonical_oracle.limits: constant-height canonical sphere, not arbitrary terrain/rotation/equal-error acceptance; diagnostic consumer only; encode_shadows() still uses the legacy patch caster

ocean_geometry.baseline: fafbf2d plus same-source paired datum consumer; target-size costs recorded by current hardware test
ocean_geometry.oracle: independent f64 direct Fourier sums, box mips, periodic bilinear/trilinear sampling and distance taper over the same discretized spectrum; not continuous-wave tessellation fidelity
verified: shared duplicates, including mixed-depth split matched to CPU topology
ocean_geometry.limits: diagnostic geometry consumer, no production raster/optical selection or RT publication; common filter includes dry near triangles; no Earth-scale phase, temporal footprint, Metal/WebGPU execution, game-FPS or equal-error claim
